  ensures (result == (forall x in xs: (count(all, x) <= count(all, b))))
  effects pure
  example (le_all([1, 2], [1, 2, 2], 2) == true)
  example (le_all([1, 2], [1, 2, 2], 1) == false)
  example (le_all([], [1], 1) == true)
{
  match xs { [] => true [h, ..t] => ((cnt(all, h) <= cnt(all, b)) and le_all(t, all, b)) }
}

fn is_best(xs: List[Int], all: List[Int], r: Option[Int]) -> Bool
  requires (len(xs) >= 0)
  ensures ((not (len(xs) == 0)) or (result == (r == None)))
  effects pure
  example (is_best([], [], None) == true)
  example (is_best([1, 2], [1, 2, 2], Some(2)) == true)
  example (is_best([1, 2], [1, 2, 2], Some(1)) == false)
{
  match r { None => (xs == []) Some(b) => ((cnt(xs, b) > 0) and le_all(xs, all, b)) }
}

fn find_best_in(to_scan: List[Int], original: List[Int]) -> Option[Int]
  requires (len(to_scan) >= 0)
  ensures is_best(to_scan, original, result)
  effects pure
  example (find_best_in([], [1, 2, 3]) == None)
  example (find_best_in([5], [1, 2, 3, 5]) == Some(5))
  example (find_best_in([1, 2], [1, 2, 2]) == Some(2))
{
  match to_scan { [] => None [h, ..t] => match find_best_in(t, original) { None => Some(h) Some(candidate) => if (cnt(original, h) > cnt(t, candidate)) then Some(h) else Some(candidate) } }
}

  requires (len(xs) == len(ys))
  ensures (len(result) == len(xs))
  ensures forall i in 0..len(result): (result[i] == (xs[i] + ys[i]))
  effects pure
  example (zip_sum([1, 2, 3], [10, 20, 30]) == [11, 22, 33])
  example (zip_sum([], []) == [])
  example (zip_sum([5], [-5]) == [0])
  example (zip_sum([-1, 0], [1, 7]) == [0, 7])
{
  match xs { [] => [] [h1, ..t1] => match ys { [] => [] [h2, ..t2] => ([(h1 + h2)] ++ zip_sum(t2, t1)) } }
}

  ensures ((not ((x >= lo) and (x <= hi))) or (result == x))

{
  if (x <= lo) then lo else if (x > hi) then hi else x
}

fn binary_search_sqrt(n: Int, low: Int, high: Int) -> Int
  requires ((((n >= 0) and (low >= 0)) and (high >= 0)) and (low <= high))
  requires ((low * low) <= n)
  requires (((high + 1) * (high + 1)) > n)
  ensures (result >= 0)
  ensures ((result * result) <= n)
  ensures (((result + 1) * (result + 1)) > n)
  effects pure
  example (binary_search_sqrt(0, 0, 0) == 0)
  example (binary_search_sqrt(1, 0, 1) == 1)
  example (binary_search_sqrt(16, 0, 16) == 4)
  example (binary_search_sqrt(17, 0, 17) == 4)
  example (binary_search_sqrt(100, 0, 100) == 10)
{
  if (low == high) then high else if ((low + 1) == high) then if ((high * high) <= n) then high else low else if ((((low + high) / 2) * ((low + high) / 2)) <= n) then binary_search_sqrt(n, ((low + high) / 2), high) else binary_search_sqrt(n, low, (((low + high) / 2) - 1))
}

fn merge_sorted(xs: List[Int], ys: List[Int]) -> List[Int]
  requires sorted(xs)
  requires sorted(ys)
  requires forall x in xs: not contains(ys, x)
  ensures sorted(result)
  ensures (len(result) == (len(xs) + len(ys)))
  ensures forall x in xs: (count(result, x) == (count(xs, x) + count(ys, x)))
  ensures forall y in ys: (count(result, y) == (count(xs, y) + count(ys, y)))
  effects pure
  example (merge_sorted([1, 4, 9], [2, 3]) == [1, 2, 3, 4, 9])
  example (merge_sorted([], [5, 6]) == [5, 6])
  example (merge_sorted([5, 6], []) == [5, 6])
  example (merge_sorted([], []) == [])
  example (merge_sorted([1, 2, 3], [7, 8]) == [1, 2, 3, 7, 8])
  example (merge_sorted([-3, 0, 10], [-5, 4]) == [-5, -3, 0, 4, 10])
{
  match xs { [] => ys [x, ..xs_rest] => match ys { [] => xs [y, ..ys_rest] => if (x <= y) then ([x] ++ merge_sorted(xs_rest, ys)) else ([y] ++ merge_sorted(xs, ys_rest)) } }
}

  requires (len(xs) >= 0)
  ensures (result == count(xs, x))
  effects pure
  example (count_of([1, 2, 2, 3], 2) == 2)
  example (count_of([], 4) == 0)
{
  match xs { [] => 0 [h, ..t] => if (h == x) then (1 + count_of(t, x)) else count_of(t, x) }

fn beats_all(all: List[Int], rest: List[Int], m: Int) -> Bool
  requires (len(rest) >= 0)
  ensures (result == (forall x in rest: ((x == m) or (count(all, x) < count(all, m)))))
  effects pure
  example (beats_all([1, 2, 2, 3], [1, 2, 2, 3], 2) == true)
  example (beats_all([1, 2, 2, 3], [1, 2, 2, 3], 1) == false)
  example (beats_all([1, 2], [], 1) == true)
{
  match rest { [] => true [h, ..t] => (((h == m) or (count_of(all, h) < count_of(all, m))) and beats_all(all, t, m)) }
}

fn mode_ok(xs: List[Int], r: Option[Int]) -> Bool
  requires (len(xs) >= 0)
  ensures ((not result) or ((len(xs) == 0) == (r == None)))
  effects pure
  example (mode_ok([1, 2, 2, 3], Some(2)) == true)
  example (mode_ok([1, 2, 2, 3], Some(1)) == false)
  example (mode_ok([1, 2, 2, 3], Some(7)) == false)
  example (mode_ok([], None) == true)
  example (mode_ok([], Some(1)) == false)
  example (mode_ok([1], None) == false)
{
  match r { None => match xs { [] => true _ => false } Some(m) => ((count_of(xs, m) > 0) and beats_all(xs, xs, m)) }
}

fn most_frequent(xs: List[Int]) -> Option[Int]
  requires ((len(xs) == 0) or (exists m in xs: forall x in xs: ((x == m) or (count(xs, x) < count(xs, m)))))
  ensures ((len(xs) == 0) == (result == None))
  ensures mode_ok(xs, result)
  effects pure
  example (most_frequent([1, 2, 2, 3]) == Some(2))
  example (most_frequent([]) == None)
  example (most_frequent([5]) == Some(5))
  example (most_frequent([3, 1, 3, 2, 1, 3]) == Some(3))
{
  match xs { [] => None [h, ..t] => if beats_all(xs, t, h) then Some(h) else most_frequent(t) }
}

fn zip_sum(xs: List[Int], ys: List[Int]) -> List[Int]
  requires (len(xs) == len(ys))
  ensures (len(result) == len(xs))
  ensures forall i in 0..len(result): (result[i] == (xs[i] + ys[i]))
  effects pure
  example (zip_sum([1, 2, 3], [10, 20, 30]) == [11, 22, 33])
  example (zip_sum([], []) == [])
  example (zip_sum([5], [-5]) == [0])
{
  match xs { [] => [] [h, ..t] => match ys { [] => [] [h2, ..t2] => ([(h + h2)] ++ zip_sum(t2, t)) } }
}
